categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three core business segments: (1) Precision Time-Space Sensing Equipment Business - providing high-precision positioning equipment and solutions for natural resources, construction, and emergency sectors; (2) Beidou High-Precision Industry Application Business - offering comprehensive solutions integrating positioning cloud platforms, industry-specific applications, and CORS network services for sectors including natural resources, transportation, water conservancy, railways, and energy; (3) Intelligent Driving and Navigation Control Application Business - providing high-precision positioning products and solutions for autonomous driving in passenger vehicles, agricultural machinery, and construction equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a comprehensive technology system spanning high-precision satellite navigation positioning (GNSS/RTK/PPP-RTK), laser LiDAR (including full-waveform technology), marine exploration (sonar/ADCP), optical-electronic measurement, and navigation control technologies. Core technologies include multi-source fusion algorithms, SLAM-RTK integration, comprehensive PNT (Positioning, Navigation, and Timing) systems, and proprietary chipsets. The company manufactures products through a combination of in-house production and outsourced assembly, with manufacturing facilities in Guangzhou, Wuhan, and Suzhou.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies and enterprises in natural resources management, transportation infrastructure, water conservancy, emergency management, railways, energy (power and petrochemical), and construction sectors. End markets span surveying and mapping, infrastructure construction, disaster monitoring, water resource management, intelligent transportation, and autonomous driving applications. The company serves both professional/industrial customers and emerging consumer markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates domestically across 28 provinces and municipalities in China with over 500 distributors. Internationally, the company has established branch offices in 12 countries and operates through two global brands (HI-TARGET and SATLAB). Key international markets include Asia-Pacific, Middle East, South America, Europe, and Africa, with recent expansion into Hungary and Uganda.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in core component manufacturing (antennas, chipsets, boards), midstream in system integration and product assembly, and downstream in direct sales to end-users and provision of comprehensive solutions and services. The company also provides data acquisition, processing, and information services, positioning it as an integrated solution provider rather than a single-point supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing multi-source fusion positioning technology combining GNSS, 5G, V2X, and other technologies; (2) developing intelligent driving solutions with focus on L2+ to L4 autonomous driving; (3) expanding Beidou high-precision applications across industries; (4) integrating AI and large language models into positioning and navigation systems; (5) pursuing international market expansion with localized operations; (6) developing next-generation products including visual-language-action models (VLA) for robotics and autonomous systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) product sales of positioning equipment, LiDAR systems, sonar equipment, and optical-electronic instruments; (2) system integration and solution implementation for industry applications; (3) data acquisition and processing services; (4) CORS network construction and operational services; (5) software licensing and cloud platform services; (6) technical support and maintenance services. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance of products/services or completion of performance obligations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of high-precision positioning solutions with significant international presence. It competes with both domestic Chinese companies and international players. The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolios spanning multiple technologies (satellite, laser, sonar, optical), strong R&D capabilities with 798 research personnel, extensive domestic distribution network, and growing international brand recognition. The company holds leading market share in specific segments like ADCP instruments and has achieved technological breakthroughs in full-waveform laser LiDAR.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated RMB 1.22 billion in revenue in 2024 (2.8% growth from 2023's RMB 1.19 billion). The company reported a net loss of RMB 12.4 million in 2024 (improved from RMB 426.7 million loss in 2023), primarily due to asset impairment charges in the time-space data business. Operating cash flow improved significantly to RMB 102.3 million in 2024 from negative RMB 36.9 million in 2023. Total assets were RMB 3.06 billion with shareholders' equity of RMB 1.56 billion as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation is built on: (1) comprehensive technology integration - combining satellite positioning, laser LiDAR, sonar, and optical technologies in unified solutions; (2) indigenous innovation - high degree of self-developed core technologies and components reducing dependence on imports; (3) industry-specific solutions - deep understanding of customer workflows in surveying, water conservancy, railways, and energy sectors; (4) reliability and precision - products achieving centimeter to millimeter-level accuracy with robust performance in complex environments; (5) ecosystem approach - providing integrated hardware, software, cloud platforms, and services rather than point products; (6) international competitiveness - products comparable to leading global competitors with superior cost-performance ratio.
